Oslo talks done: Zelensky claims "positive signals," Witkoff takes a peace framework to Russia on Wednesday

Zelensky met Witkoff, Norwegian PM Støre and Finnish President Stubb in Oslo (Kushner joined remotely — reportedly ill). Trump said "it's time" for a peace deal.
